issues.where: Bring hither, O youngest ... the best brilliant wealth, O good one, much desired.
issues.problem: 'much desired' hangs after the vocative 'O good one' although puruspṛham agrees with rayim (the draft's own note); readers will take it as describing the vocative.
issues.fix: Bring hither the best, brilliant, much desired wealth, O youngest, O Bhārata, O Agni, O good one.

patch.value: Bring hither the best, brilliant, much desired wealth, O youngest, O Bhārata, O Agni, O good one.

issues.where: हे वसु, जो बहुतों का चाहा हुआ है
issues.problem: Same misplacement, plus 'जो ... है' adds a relative clause and 'हे वसु' clashes with English 'good one' (and with the glossary's Vasus).
issues.fix: हे सबसे युवा, हे भारत, हे अग्नि, श्रेष्ठ, तेजस्वी, बहुतों के चाहे हुए धन को यहाँ लाओ, हे उत्तम।

patch.value: हे सबसे युवा, हे भारत, हे अग्नि, श्रेष्ठ, तेजस्वी, बहुतों के चाहे हुए धन को यहाँ लाओ, हे उत्तम।

summary: RV 2.7. Draft is sound; only two minor wording points (word order of 'much desired', untranslated aṣṭāpadī). No regrouping.
